sources.entry: WalkAITalkie - Menu bar dictation for Apple Silicon Macs, with local speech recognition and text cleanup that work offline after model download. #freemium

summary.name: WalkAITalkie
summary.one_liner: A menu bar dictation app for Apple Silicon Macs that turns speech into text locally, with optional text cleanup and a one-time-purchase Pro tier.
use_cases: Dictating messages and emails on a Mac
Recording on-site meeting notes without a bot
Translating dictated text into another language
summary.what_it_does: Runs from the Mac menu bar: you hold a key (Right Option by default in the direct download) or press once to start and once to stop, then speech is transcribed. Speech recognition runs on the Mac and works offline once models are downloaded. Clean Up removes filler words while keeping the wording; a raw transcript is always available first. The direct download can paste text at the cursor, while the Mac App Store version copies text for manual ⌘V. Pro adds more output formats, translation into 38 languages, session notes from microphone recordings, and a custom dictionary.
notable: Local speech recognition with Parakeet and Whisper engines, 38 dictation languages
Free tier includes unlimited dictation, Raw and Clean Up, and history; Pro is a one-time $7.99 purchase
Optional Codex or Claude Code CLI hand-off for faster session notes, off by default
caveats: Requires macOS 26+ and Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
Session notes capture microphone only, not Zoom or Teams system audio; Pro features and cloud accelerator are direct-download only
Mac App Store version copies text to the clipboard rather than pasting it
